capabilities: chat with Grok in a desktop sidebar or mobile sheet
ask Grok about a note or selection and insert, replace, or copy the reply
summarize, rewrite, fix grammar, or continue writing with quick-action chips
generate images from a prompt, note, or folder and save or embed them
configure the xAI API key and choose a Grok model
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; must be installed manually from release files. API usage is billed separately by xAI. Detailed docs live in separate files (install.md, imagine.md).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model from inside a note on both desktop and mobile.

relations.evidence: This plugin sends the text you choose (selection, note, prompt, or notes in the open note's folder) to xAI

summary: Chat with Grok via the xAI API in a desktop sidebar or mobile sheet, sending notes or selections and inserting, replacing, or copying the reply.
